content: Mihsahahnica joi
Jaatian ta hian patax tsahoti Jesus canishqui, xobohoh quehax picotax.
Hian quetsahohtaiya sca hihti caibo hahqui tsinquijaqueti becani. Jaa copi ta nontin sca nanenishqui, nontin tsahoxon quexa nichibo haxemanoxon.
Haxemaquin ta jaa patax queha joibo jato hicha yohinishqui. Nescajaquin jato yohiquin: Huesti huaijanicah ta jahuen trigo banahi canishqui.
Huai chian sca trigo berobo mihsahahbonahi cahi. Mihsahahbonahah cahen caibo berobo bahin paquecanahi. Jascapa ta pehiyahpabaan topiquin queyonishqui.
Caibo berobo rihbi cahen chahoma main paquenish. Bemacanya mashi jai. Mai chicho hihyamahax copi cahen jascapa histon joconish.
Bari xanascaiya sca cahen joconaibo histon xanahi, mai chicho jaton tapon cayamahiya.
Caibo moxa chian paqueti. Jaabo joconai bi cahen moxan rishquiquin, hashoan hani sca hihxon.

Caibo berobo rihbi cahen mai siri janin paqueti. Jaabo cahen joconax, hanihax bimiscai. Caibo cahen huesti bero potahah cien beroyahpascai. Caibo cahen sesenta beroyahpascai. Caibo cahen treinta beroyahpascai.
Hahan nincati pabinquiyahpaboxon nincanahue —hahquin.
Jaa patax queha joi Jesusen yohihi
Jaa pecaho sca jahuen haxenicabo jaabo rahsibi Jesus qui caxon yocacanquin: —¿Jahua copi min jaa patax queha joibo res yohiquin jato haxemahin? —hahquin.
Yocacahbo sca: —Papan jihuemati jenquetsahpa quin man honannon hihxon tah hen jaa patax queha joi yohihi. Hoa caibaan nincaxon bi honanyamanon hihxon tah hen jascajahi.
Jaton jointi janin Papan shinan pishca jaibo tah hen hashoan hinantihi, hicha bi res jan janon. Jaton jointi janin jai shinan yamahibo tah hen jaa jaibo pishca rihbi jato bichintihi.
Jaa copi tah hen jaa patax queha joi jato yohihi. Jaatian ta jisquin bi jistimacantihiqui. Nincaquin bi ta nincarestihiqui, honanyamaquin.
Isaiasnen huishani joi jai quesca sca ta jaresscaiqui.

content.text: Pabinquinin nincaxon bi tah man honantimatihi. Beron jisquin bi tah man jistimatihi.

Nincayosmaboxon copi tah man jascajatihi. Pabinquiyaxon bi hochoxon nincacai quescajaquin. Jistihi bi tah man bero rahcohi, jismis hihxon. Nincamis hihxon rihbi, jointinin nincaxon, shinan pontehax rohahax jihuemis hihxon tah man jascajahi.

content: hih ta jaiqui Isaiasnen huishani joi.
Jahuerohajaquin tah man jascajaxonma beron jisxon jiscoinai. Jahuerohajaquin tah man pabinquiyahpaboxon nincacoinai.

Man jisibo ta hicha Papan joi yohinicabo jisti queenpahonishqui. Pontejaquin shinanaibaan hihti jiscatsihxon bi man jisi jisyamaquin. Man nincacai joibo hihti nincacatsihquibaan bi ta Papan jato nincamayamanishqui. Jaa copi sca Jahuerohajaquin ta Papan noque jismahiqui, Jahuerohajaquin ta noque nincamahiqui, hihnahue.
Mihsahahnica jahuahi jaiquin hihxon jan yohihi
Bananica joi jahua hihcatsihquiquin mato hen yohinon nincanahue.

Papan jihuemati joi yohihah bi honanyamahi joni ta bahinbi bero paquetai quesca qui. Jahuen jointi janin banaquin hahcajaquin non nincamaha bi cahen joxon, non yohiha joi tiroma yoshiman bichinbahinquin.
Chahoma main bero paquetai ta nincamenoxon jenimaxon bichi quescapah qui.
Jahuen tapon chicho cayamahi quesca sca basiyamahi. Jaa joi jan bihcoinai copi caibaan hosan hosanquin. Hosanah sca histon jenescaquin. Masa tenetihi bi jenebahini caresi.

Moxa chian paquetaibo ta joi bihcoinxon bi huetsa shinanboya jaxon caijayamahibo quescascai qui. Nincacoinxon bi ta mai mehabaan shinanai quescajaquin shinanxon, jaton jahuaborabo rihbi shinanxon jaa joi caimayamahiqui, bimijoma quesca sca jan janon.

Mai siripan banaha bero ta nincanica joni quescapah qui. Joi nincaxon, jahuen shinaman nincacoinxon, shinan caijaquin. Bero caichi jai quescarihbihi jahuen shinan, caibo quiha cien bero sca, caibo quiha sesenta, caibo quiha treinta.
Trigo tocan huasi joconcanahi
Huetsa jaa patax quehah joi rihbi ta nescajaquin jato yohinishqui. Papan jihuemati ta bananica jai quesca qui. Jahuen huai chian caxon cahen banaquin jahuen berobo mihsahahbonaquin.
Mihsahahquipish yame hoxahiya sca jahuen rahui jahui. Joxon, jaa huai chian sca banahipibo bero tocan jahuen huasi bero mihsahahbonahax caresscai.
Trigo bero joconax hani sca jaax beroyahpa sca jaiya bi cahen huasi jascarihbihi, beroyahpascai.
Trigo tocan huasi jai jisxon ta jahuen jonibaan sca yocatihiqui: —¿Siri bero rahsi min banayamahohquin, Patoron? ¿Siri rahsi potahi shinanah bi jenquetsahpi huasi sca jaiquin?
Jaatian ta jaton patoronen jato yohitihiqui: —Jaa ta noquen rahuin noque jascajanhoxqui —hahquin. —¿Hoa huasibo non mexahi catimahin —hih sca jacani.
—Mexayamaquin rahan. Huasi mexaquin bi jayabi trigo rihbi man mexamis.

Jatihibi haninon jenenahue. Trigo tsinquiti tian pari caxon tah non tsinquixonnicahbo yohitihi. Huasi pari mexanahue. Huasi mexaxon nexaxon cohati sca tsamanhihninahue. Trigo bero rahsi sca tsinquixon jano bexojati xobo janin bexojaxonnahue —hah sca jato jatihi.
Jaton moxo bero
Huetsa jaa patax queha joi rihbi ta jato yohinishqui. Papan jihuemati ta moxo bero pishca jai quescarihbihiqui. Jascapa bero pishca cahen huai chian hihbaan banahah joconi.
Caibo bero mentan hashoan hexti pishcahax bi ta joconax hani sca jaax texe banabo mentan hashoan hani sca jaiqui. Jihuiscaiya ta hihsabo joxon jahuen mebibo janin sca nahajatihiqui.
Hahan paan soohihmati

Huetsa jaa patax queha joi rihbi ta nescajaquin yohinishqui. Paan hahnica haibaan ta jahuen paan soohihmanoxon hahan soohihmati bihnicah qui. Jascapa bihxon cahen huesti paniro tihopa tonco janin niaquin. Jano niahah ta tonco jatihibi soohihtihiqui. Papan jihuemati ta jascarihbihihqui, non honanaima bi hanihi —jato jaquin.
Jaa patax queha joi rahsi
Jascapahbo jaa patax queha joibo ta Jesusen jato haxemanishqui, tsinquitax tsamajaquetaibo yohiquin. Jaa patax joibo rahsichin ta jato haxemanishqui. Jayajoma jahuabi jato yohiyamaquin.
Jaa copi ta Papan joi yohinicaten huishani jai quesca janishqui.

content.text: Jaa patax queha joibo yohiquin tah hen jato haxemahi. Jahuentianbi nincanihmabo joi tah hen jato nincamahi

content: hih ta jaiqui huishani joi.
Huasi jahua hihcatsihquiquin hihxon jan yohihi
Tsamataibo potabahini sca Jesus cahi, xoboho hihcohi. Jano rihbi ta jahuen haxenicabo hihconishqui, yocacatsihqui. —¿Huasi bero joi jahua hihcatsihquiquin? Noque yohihue —hahcanquin.
—Nesca tah qui, jisnahue —jato jaquin.— Siri berobo banahi joni ta noquebaque qui.
Jahuen huai ta nai naman yohihi qui. Jahuen bero siribo ta Papan jihuetahbo qui. Huasibo cahen tiroma yoshiman jonibo.
Jahuen rahui cahen Satanas. Jahuen tsinquiti tian cahen nea nete queyotai hihcatsihqui. Jahuen tsinquixonnicahbo cahen Papan yonotibo.
Jascarihbihi, huasi mexaxon cohahi jaibo quescarihbihi ta nea nete queyotaiya jayaxihquiqui.
Noquebaque hihxon tah hen heen yonotibo raanyaxihqui. Caxon ta hohchamanicahboya tiromajahibo tsinquiyaxihcanihqui. Jascapahbo ta Papan jihuematima janin boyaxihcanihqui.
Jato boxon ta johuehihnatai chihi janin jato potayaxihcanihqui. Jano ta sai saihihyaxihcanihqui. Jaton xeta yeres yeresahquin, hisin tenequin.
Jaatian ta bari coshi xaba jai quescarihbihi, Papan jihuetahbo siribo coshi shinanyahpa hihyaxihcanihqui, Papan jihuemati janin. Pabinquiyahpaxon nincanahue.
Jonenihbo coriqui

Papan jihuemati ta nahue chian tsama coriqui jonenoxon mihinnihbo quescapah qui. Jaa mihinnihbo meraxon cahen huetsa jonin mahporihbihax hihti jenimahi caxon jan jai jatihibi maromatihi. Maromaxon ta coriqui bihxon jahan sca jaa nahue marotihiqui, jaa mihinnihbo jahuenah sca hihnon.
Copi moro
Papan jihuemati ta marocatsihquin moro copibo benahi maronica nihnichi quescapah rihbi qui.
Huesti moro hihti siri, hihti queenti siri meraxon cahen caxon jan jai jatihibi maromaxon sca jaa moro siri maroscaquin.
Mesco yapa rahcoxon caisaibo
Papan jihuemati ta tarrafa quesca rihbi qui. Tarrafa cahen hian janin potaxon mesco yapa rahcocanquin.
Bochoscaiya ninixon mapemaxon yapa tsecapaquescacanquin. Tsecapaquexon caispaquecanquin. Tsahoxon sca tasa qui siribo nanehihniquin, tiromabo potapaquequin.
Nete queyotaiya ta jascaja rihbi Papan jayaxihquiqui. Joxon ta Papan yonotibaan tiromabo bihyaxihcanihqui, siribo tocan nihyamascanon.
Johuehihnatai chihi janin ta jato potayaxihcanihqui. Jano ta sai saihihyaxihcanihqui. Xeta ta yeres yeresahyaxihcanihqui, hisin tenequin.
Behnaboya xenibo jismahibo
—¿Hen mato yohihi jatihibi man nincaxon nincacoinain? —jato jaah: —Nincaquin rahan —hihcani.

—Jaa copi tah man Papan jihuetahbohax jahuen jihuetahbo haxescaxon caibo rihbi sca man haxematihi. Jaatian tah man hicha jahuaborayahpa hani patoro quesca man jatihi. Jascapah cahen jahuen bexojati chiqueho caxon behnaboya xenibo siribo cainmatihiqui —jato jaquin.
Nazaret janin Jesus nocorihbihi
Jascajaquin jaa patax queha joibo jato yohiquin queyohax, janohax Jesus cahi.

Jahuen main cahi. Cahi nocotax jaton tsinquiti xoboho mapexon janoxon jahuen caibo Papan joi yohiquin. Jaan jato haxemaha, rahte rahtecani. —¿Jahuerahnon haxenihxon hen neatohon yotiho honannishquin? ¿Jenquetsahaxon coshi bihxon jonibo rohajahiquin?
¿Xobojahnicaten baque ma hin? ¿María janeya jahuen mama ma quin? ¿Jacobo, José, Simon, Judas jahuen huetsaboma quin?
¿Jahuen chocabo jatihibi noque betanbi jihueyamacaniquin? ¿Jahuen sca hen jahuen shinan bihnishquin? —hihcani.

Jaa copi nincacoinyamacanquin. Nincacoinyamahibo copi sca Jesusen jato yohiquin: —Papan joi yohinicahon huetsancohabo queenaibaan bi ta jahuen mai janinhahbo jahan queenyamacaniqui. Jahuen jenabo, jahuen xobo janinhahbo, jaabo jahan queenyamarihbihi —jato jaquin.
Nincayosmabo copi ta jahuen coshiyaxon jaton jema janin jato hicha hahxonyamanishqui.
